profileEvidence.author: B
profileEvidence.summary: Bold, sociable and keen to join its people, the Toy Rat Terrier combines family affection with a lively hunting instinct. It may greet returning people with enthusiastic kisses, solicit play and quickly sound an alarm at something new. This small size retains the athletic build and vermin-hunting heritage of the Rat Terrier.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: An affectionate, alert little Rat Terrier, the Toy retains a keen hunting instinct and often greets its people with gusto.
